name: managebac-mcp
description: Unofficial ManageBac connector (MCP server) for Claude, on Cloudflare Workers

MB_HOST.description: Your school's ManageBac address without `https://`, e.g. `yourschool.managebac.com`.

MB_LOGIN.description: The email you sign in to ManageBac with.

MB_PASSWORD.description: Your ManageBac password. Stored as an encrypted Worker secret; only your Worker can read it.

MCP_SECRET.description: A long random string you make up (at least 16 letters and numbers). It becomes the end of your connector URL, like `...workers.dev/mcp/YOUR_SECRET`. Anyone with that URL can read your ManageBac, so keep it private.

SESSION.description: Storage for the login session. Leave the default.
